shape.rule: adopt if the selection-window gain is ≥ 0.001 per game and the moneyline is not worse by more than 0.0002
shape.verdict: REJECTED: the selection-window gain is -0.000198 per game (needs ≥ 0.001); the pace overdispersion term was never preferred by any season's history (the 60-minute score is not overdispersed relative to the model)

period_profile.rule: adopt the fine profile if, on SELECTION, the first-period score log-likelihood gains ≥ 0.001 per game, the 60-minute score log-likelihood does not fall, and the moneyline log loss does not rise by more than 0.0002
period_profile.disclosure: the rule was written after an exploratory run that had read both windows (2026-10-13)
